title: fix(rest): a hook's onError abort is no longer logged as an unhandled error
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Refs #27508 (log half)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:hook 以 `onError: 'abort'`(默认)抛出业务错误中止写入时,服务端不再把它记成 `[REST] Unhandled error`;线上应答(400、正文、信封)一个字节都不变。
- **为什么改**:这是路由已经答复给调用方的拒绝,不是故障;运维在 error 日志里分不清「有意中止」和「真崩溃」。分诊裁定只做日志这一半,错误码那一半另走 spec 车道。
- **风险与回滚**:只影响日志判定,不动应答;豁免只认「沙箱体抛出、非崩溃、未声明 code、4xx」的拒绝,崩溃和其他来源的无码 4xx 照旧记录。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/rest/src/error-response.ts` 的 `isSandboxBodyRefusal` 与 `logUnexpectedRouteError` 调用处;`packages/rest/src/rest-declared-client-refusal-log.test.ts` 新增的 describe 块。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-declared-client-refusal-log.test.ts`,预期 16 条全绿(其中 hook 中止两扇门都无 Unhandled 行,三条对照照旧记录)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`: a new predicate, `isSandboxBodyRefusal`, joins the three reads `logUnexpectedRouteError` already makes. It is true when all three hold:
  1. the answer is in the 4xx band;
  2. the error carries a sandboxed body's business sentence (`sandboxBusinessMessage`: `innerMessage` set, and not a native-error crash); and
  3. the body declared no code (`resolveThrownHttpError(...).declaredCode` is absent). This is read off the thrown error, not the answer, so a code the door itself adds to an undeclared abort later does not make the abort loud again.
- Nothing on the wire moves. `resolveErrorResponse`, `mapDataError` and `packages/types` are untouched. The ADR-0112 ledger is not touched and no code is minted; that half belongs to the spec lane.
- Operators keep a line for each abort: the BodyRunner already logs every body refusal at `info` (`[BodyRunner] sandboxed hook refused`). The error-level line removed here was the second line for one ordinary refusal.
- Docblocks on `isExpectedRouteError` and `isDeclaredClientRefusal` that said the sandbox unwrap's un-coded 400 "is still logged" now point at the new read.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/rest` patch.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/rest-declared-client-refusal-log.test.ts`. The standing control "an un-coded business-rule 400 (a sandboxed hook refusal) logs" pinned the old verdict, so it moves into a new block that pins what triage ruled. It goes through the real route handlers (`POST /api/v1/data/:object` through `mapDataError` + `logUnexpectedRouteError`, and `PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` through `handleRouteError`):
  - a hook abort answers exactly `{ error: 'boom abort', object: 'qa_media' }` at 400 on the data door and `{ error: 'boom abort' }` at 400 on the meta door, both `toEqual`, and logs no `[REST] Unhandled error` line;
  - CONTROL: a genuine `TypeError` at the same door is a 500 and is logged, checked by identity;
  - CONTROL: an un-coded 400 from a producer that is not a sandboxed body is still logged;
  - CONTROL: a sandboxed body that threw an unregistered code is still logged;
  - the existing loud controls are unchanged, including the sandbox crash that declared a 4xx envelope (500, logged) and the registered code on an undeclared status.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/object-hook-lifecycle-scratch.dogfood.test.ts` acceptance[6] is the real door with a real QuickJS `SandboxError`: a `beforeInsert` hook declared `onError: 'abort'` throws. It now also asserts the exact body `{ error, object }` and that the request logs no `[REST] Unhandled error` line.

<details><summary>Ablation 1: unit route pin (remove the call-site exemption, then restore)</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with the anchor on the `&& !isSandboxBodyRefusal(error, resolved)` call-site line, at head `2e4954fd`:


Both tests fail only at the log assertion. Their status and exact-body assertions come first and pass under the ablation, which is the pre-change logic. So the wire answer is the same as before.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope of the marker.** `SandboxError` carries no body kind, so a sandboxed action's code-less business refusal answered at a data door is quiet too. It is the same shape and the same answer. A message-prefix read (`hook '…' threw:`) would tell the two apart, but that would be a text heuristic, so it was not used.
- **Overlap with the code half.** The open draft #27667 (the spec-lane card for the code half) edits the same test file. It changes the control this PR moves (it asserts `HOOK_ABORTED` and "still logs"), so a text conflict in `rest-declared-client-refusal-log.test.ts` is expected for whichever PR lands second. The predicate reads the thrown error's code, not the answer's, so a door-assigned `HOOK_ABORTED` keeps the abort quiet. When that PR rebases, its "still logs" line should become "quiet".
- The undeclared-code-under-a-catalogue case (`undeclaredHookRefusalAtRun`) becomes a `SandboxError` with no `innerMessage`. That is the sandbox's own fault (500), so it stays loud, unchanged.

## Verification

All local readings below are at head `2e4954fd` unless noted.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/object-hook-lifecycle-scratch.dogfood.test.ts`: `Tests 4 passed (4)`, exit 0.

</details>

Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 64 exited 0. The run was split across a container restart: the families not yet run were re-run at the same head, `2e4954fd`. `check:type-check-debt` was run whole under the verify lock after a queue timeout gave it PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3). Its re-run exited 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 0 once a full build had run, after an earlier PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3).
